description.en: Replace the collect points of the team's loyalty program (QR codes, Advent doors, checkpoints where customers collect points themselves). Entries are matched by key: existing keys keep their id and history, keys left out are removed. Requires team manage permission.
description.de: Ersetzt die Sammelpunkte des Treueprogramms (QR-Codes, Advent-Türchen, Checkpoints, an denen Kunden selbst Punkte sammeln). Einträge werden per Key zugeordnet: bestehende Keys behalten ID und Verlauf, weggelassene Keys werden entfernt. Benötigt Team-Verwaltungsrechte.

warp.bot: Load the program first and send the FULL list (it replaces all collect points). Each entry: key, name, source, points, optional limit (once | daily | per_window), windowMinutes (required for per_window), startsAt, endsAt, active, code, codeRotation (none | daily), meta. Omit code to keep the existing one, pass null to remove it. codeRotation daily makes the code change every midnight in the team timezone (no fixed code allowed then); omit codeRotation to keep the current mode. Today's daily code is never returned to agents; only signed-in team members see it (loyalty editor, checkpoint display). Never echo fixed codes back to customers in public channels.

warp.bot: Use when the user wants to start a return on a paid order after items were shipped, delivered, or picked up. Pass items as JSON like [{"orderItemId":1,"quantity":1}] using numeric orderItemId from get_order. Optional fulfillmentId links the return to a shipment. On success RETURN_ID and RETURN_STATUS must be set — if empty, treat as failure and inspect the API error. Verify with list_returns or get_order.returns before claiming success.
